versions.subject: Create win_external_device
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 
        - 6416
    DeviceClassName: 'DiskDrive'  
selection2:
    DeviceDescription: 'USB Mass Storage Device'
condition: selection or selection2
versions.spl: (EventID=6416 DeviceClassName="DiskDrive") OR DeviceDescription="USB Mass Storage Device"
